title: Where I stand on the ladder

points.text: The academy's format ladder describes any practitioner's work by three axes.

outline.heading: The laws of the “one to one” step

points.text: Every step has its own laws.

outline.heading: A step, not a waiting room

points.text: The ladder says otherwise: a higher step is not better than a lower one; you can work on any of them for years.

points: The format ladder from the academy uses three axes to describe your work as a practitioner.
Each step on the ladder has its own laws.
The ladder shows that a higher step is not better than a lower one and you can work on any step for years.
